description:
Body of a reference-lock annotation.

Records that ``locked_artifact_ids`` are the canonical anchor for
``subject_id`` (a ``subject_kind``), the aspects a supervisor should
compare (``checklist``), which of those block vs merely warn
(``hard_gates``), and the advisory identity threshold
(``min_similarity``).

subject_kind.description: What this lock anchors — character / location / style / prop / other.
subject_kind.title: Subject Kind

subject_id.description: Id (or stable name) of the entity this lock anchors — e.g. a character-ref / location-ref annotation id.
subject_id.title: Subject Id

locked_artifact_ids.description: 1..N reference artifact / annotation ids that *are* the canonical anchor. One canonical image, or a set (front / three-quarter / full-body / expressions).
locked_artifact_ids.title: Locked Artifact Ids

primary_artifact_id.description: The representative artifact to display; must be one of ``locked_artifact_ids``. Defaults to the first when omitted.
primary_artifact_id.title: Primary Artifact Id

scope_ref.description: When ``scope == 'scene'``, the scene/segment id this lock applies to. Must be None for project scope.
scope_ref.title: Scope Ref

checklist.description: Aspects the supervisor compares against the anchor — e.g. 'face', 'architecture', 'props', 'lighting', 'costume', 'palette'. Strings (not Literal) so new aspects need no schema bump.
checklist.title: Checklist

hard_gates.description: Subset of ``checklist`` that BLOCKS on mismatch (auto-reject / queue regen). Empty by default → every aspect is advisory (flag, never auto-block).
hard_gates.title: Hard Gates

min_similarity.description: Advisory identity-similarity threshold in [0, 1]; a candidate scoring below this is flagged as drift. None → use the supervisor's system default.
min_similarity.title: Min Similarity

supersedes.description: Prior reference-lock annotation id this re-lock replaces (costume change, scene re-lock). None for the first lock.
supersedes.title: Supersedes

notes.description: Human checklist hints the vision supervisor can use — e.g. 'the green flat cap is present', 'same bar layout'.
notes.title: Notes

params.description: Opaque per-aspect config (e.g. per-aspect thresholds). Ignored by lacing; consumed by the producing supervisor.
params.title: Params

title: ReferenceLockBodyV1
